## IValidateSarifReviewInput.sarif property

The SARIF 2.1.0 log as a parsed JSON object (not text). It is copied when the call starts; later changes to your object have no effect. Values JSON cannot represent are refused rather than dropped.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly sarif: object;
```
